{"code": "import numpy as np

# Confirm the number of missing values in the two variables of interest
print(f"Missing flipper_length_mm: {penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Missing body_mass_g: {penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")

# Check which rows are missing
missing_rows = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()]
print("\nRows with missing values in either variable:")
print(missing_rows[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']])

# Drop rows with missing values in either variable
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the clean dataset
print(f"\nClean dataset shape: {penguins_clean.shape}")
print(f"Number of valid pairs: {len(penguins_clean)}")

# Compute the Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f"\nPearson correlation: {correlation}")"}
